messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep-dive (60–90m)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today; great discussion and appreciate the clarity on your inference profile and peak patterns. As discussed, the next best step is a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/Infra leads so we can:

- Walk through your current serving topology and bottlenecks (latency / KV cache).
- Validate inference economics and target throughput.
- Draft a mutual action plan (owners + acceptance criteria).

Proposed session goals (short):
1) 10m — context + success criteria
2) 30–45m — architecture review & performance constraints
3) 15–30m — runbook/rollout constraints and SLA targets
4) 5–10m — action items & next steps

Time options (PST):
- Tue Dec 7 — 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed Dec 8 — 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu Dec 9 — 08:30–10:00 or 14:00–15:30

Please reply with the slot that works best and the list of internal folks you want on (I saw you mentioned Priya for infra — happy to include her).

Attachments: redwood-tdx-proposal-1.0.pdf (agenda + prep checklist)

If helpful, I can also send a short poll / calendar invite once you confirm a preferred window.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
